groups.rationale: 穿着、出游与极端天气决策是规划的部分内容，原文未证明这些子项覆盖全部规划场景。

evidence_quotes.quote: So for me, primary purpose is a planning. So whenever I use weather app, it's either to plan what I have to wear on a particular day or plan my outdoor activities. or just plan my trip or something.
